page.overview:
Who is Headhunters?

The "Headhunters" are Headman's narcotics guard. Whose members are recruited from among the most ruthless and greediest of the world's drug dealers and criminals. In exchange for their absolute loyalty and obedience, the Headman gives them a financial stake in his global drug empire. Category:Headhunters Category:A Real American Hero characters
